faq.q: What is the price of plots for sale in Guduvanchery?
faq.a: Starting at around ₹4,500 per sq.ft., with 600 sq.ft. options around ₹27 lakhs and larger plots up to ₹1.1 crore. Direct owner sales eliminate middlemen and hidden costs.

faq.q: What is the plot rate appreciation trend in Guduvanchery?
faq.a: Rates have surged 15–20% annually, driven by IT growth and metro links — up from around ₹3,500/sq.ft. five years ago to the current ₹4,500–₹6,500/sq.ft. range.

faq.q: Is investing in plots in Guduvanchery a good long-term decision?
faq.a: Yes — proximity to Mahindra City, rising demand, and DTCP/CMDA approvals support 20%+ ROI potential over 5 years.

faq.q: What is the stamp duty for buying land in Guduvanchery?
faq.a: Tamil Nadu stamp duty is 7% on market value for plots over ₹10 lakhs, plus a 1% registration fee. Women buyers receive a 1% rebate.

faq.q: Can I get a home loan for buying a plot in Guduvanchery?
faq.a: Banks offer up to 80% loans with interest rates starting at 8.5%, and tenures up to 30 years. Plot loans convert to home loans post-construction.

faq.q: Are plots in Guduvanchery DTCP or CMDA approved?
faq.a: Yes — fully DTCP and CMDA approved, ensuring legal validity, bank loans, and clear titles from direct owners.

faq.q: What documents should I check before buying a plot in Guduvanchery?
faq.a: Patta, chitta, encumbrance certificate (last 30 years), DTCP/CMDA approval, survey sketch, and any road-widening NOC.

faq.q: Are plots in Guduvanchery RERA registered?
faq.a: Projects comply with RERA where applicable, though individual plots often fall outside full registration. OmShakthy provides RERA-equivalent disclosures.

faq.q: Can NRIs buy plots in Guduvanchery?
faq.a: Yes — via repatriable funds, with RBI approval for amounts under $250,000/year. Power of Attorney enables remote purchases.

faq.q: Is Guduvanchery a good place to buy a plot?
faq.a: Yes — it blends affordability, growth, and amenities, with high appreciation potential and a family-friendly setting.

faq.q: What are the popular localities to buy plots near Guduvanchery?
faq.a: Singaperumal Koil, Maraimalai Nagar, and Padur — all within 10 km, offering similar growth patterns.
GST Road, 2 km to the railway station, and buses to Chennai (40 minutes), plus upcoming Metro Phase 2 and airport links.

faq.q: What are the upcoming infrastructure projects near Guduvanchery?
faq.a: Metro extension, elevated GST corridor, ORR Phase 2, IT SEZs, and hospital expansions.

faq.q: What sizes of plots are available in Guduvanchery?
faq.a: Ranges from 600 sq.ft. to 2,400 sq.ft., with corner and east-facing options available.

faq.q: Are there gated community plots in Guduvanchery?
faq.a: Yes — with 24/7 security, parks, and internal roads in premium gated community layouts.
